Bug1_YourFleetGridShowsNoShips
.`myBoard shows SHIP cells when Room has fleet saved before VM init`()
.`myBoard has exactly 17 SHIP cells for full standard fleet`()
.`myBoard is all WATER when Room has no saved placements`()
.`ownShips list contains all 5 ship types from saved fleet`()
.`PlayerSlot TWO placements are NOT loaded into myBoard (slot isolation)`()
.`latest write wins when saveBoardState called twice with same gameId`()
Bug2_HitsNeverRegister
.`opponent shot on Carrier cell resolves to HIT in myBoard`()
.`opponent shot on empty cell (9,9) resolves to MISS`()
.`MISS does not alter any ship cells (17 cells still occupied after miss)`()
.`two hits and one miss all resolve independently`()
.`engine root cause — fireShot on emptyList always returns Miss (documents Bug 2)`()

.`row 10 cells (indices 90–99) all present in opponentBoard`()
